scope: 20 development questions, 112 frozen cases; sealed independent Test 15 untouched
conclusion: Candidate retention stage complete, precision-mapping interface identified but no verified Trial2 final F1/nDCG run. No evidence of end-to-end improvement.
verified_findings: Functional mapping has local pure functions extract(text, rules), case_profile(case,rules), compare(query,case), ranking_key(whole,branches,retrieval_score,cid). These can calculate rule-based task matching without paying an API.

The historical new20 rank trace script performs genuine 20-question inference but checks frozen BGE-M3 hashes and calls the historical all-112 predict pipeline; it does not expose a controlled per-query candidate-pool injection interface.

The original heldout_run.predict needs a frozen local SentenceTransformer BGE-M3 checkpoint, existing embedding/model data and package versions; running it is not the same as executing Trial2's new candidate policy.
The Trial2 script and CI workflow read stored Dense/BM25/Hybrid ranks and compute candidate recall only. Neither calls precision mapping nor writes downstream F1/nDCG.

Any end-to-end Trial2 comparison requires an explicitly implemented, tested candidate-pool handoff into the unchanged mapping, matching candidate-count policy, and repeated-output metrics. This has NOT been implemented or executed in this checkpoint.
The existing matched-20 post-hoc candidate recall is 0.5096 for Hybrid and 0.71695 for alternating Dense/BM25. That does not prove final recommendation quality.
Existing relevant labels are provisional; no independent model ensemble adjudication completed.
blocker: No validated fixed-architecture Trial2 candidate-injection adapter and no corresponding end-to-end CI metric artifacts; implementation/rerun would be new work and user requested stop after current work.
